gloss: rock fishing; shore fishing from rocky coasts

definitions.gloss: rock fishing; shore fishing from rocky coasts
definitions.explanation: Recreational fishing done from rocky shorelines or coastal rocks, often targeting fish like {黒鯛|くろだい} or メジナ. A distinct style from boat fishing or pier fishing.

examples.english: I went rock fishing with my father.

examples.japanese: {磯釣|いそづ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{滑|すべ}り{止|ど}め→滑り止め：27612_suberidome⟧⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: For rock fishing, non-slip shoes are essential.

examples.japanese: ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{磯釣|いそづ}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}した→中止する：21909_chuushisuru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: On days with high waves, rock fishing is dangerous, so you should call it off.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{磯|いそ}→磯：05389_iso⟧ (rocky shore) + ⟦{釣|つ}り→釣り：03439_tsuri⟧ (fishing), with rendaku (つり → づり). A serious hobby with its own gear and culture; considered one of the more rugged styles of recreational fishing due to the terrain and exposure to waves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {磯釣|いそづ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go rock fishing
- {磯釣|いそづ}り{師|し}: a rock-fishing enthusiast
- {磯釣|いそづ}り⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧: a rock-fishing spot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {船釣|ふなづ}り: boat fishing — from a boat at sea
- ⟦{投|な}げ→投げ：21942_nage⟧{釣|づ}り: surf casting — long-distance casting from a beach
- {渓流釣|けいりゅうづ}り: mountain stream fishing — in rivers, not the sea
